richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Hajipur

c: Hajipur sits across the Ganga from Patna. It is home to the zonal headquarters of the East Central Railway, so office campuses and staff quarters make up a large part of its open ground. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to office campuses, staff colonies, schools and municipal parks in Hajipur. The machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,440 km away, and come to Bihar by road.

Office staff in Hajipur tend to use an outdoor gym in two short windows, before office hours and after them. That means several people want a machine at the same time. We plan for that by suggesting stations that serve two or three users on one frame. We fix them through our own team or an eastern India dealer, on a grouted or self-standing base. Send us the site size and photos, and we will mark every station and its clear space on a layout drawing.

items.q: Which machines suit an office campus in Hajipur?
items.a: Machines that take several users at once, such as the Seating Twister Three Way, work well when staff arrive together. Add a walker and one strength machine to cover the whole body.

items.q: How do you install equipment on soft river-plain soil?
items.a: We usually grout the base in concrete set below the soft top layer. A raised, well-drained area around the machines also stops water from standing after heavy rain.

items.q: Do you deliver outdoor gym equipment to Hajipur?
items.a: Yes. We send the equipment from Vasai by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in eastern India, as per the approved layout drawing.
